newsitem.title: GERMANY: ProSieben sees slower ad market growth.
newsitem.headline: ProSieben sees slower ad market growth.

text.p: German television group ProSieben Media AG said on Monday it expected stable but slower growth in the German television advertising market.
"We are seeing growth, but we are also seeing extreme growth in competition," ProSieben board member and marketing director Michael Woelfle told Reuters in an interview.
ProSieben last month reported a 21 percent rise in advertising revenues for the first six months of 1997 to 1.55 billion marks.
Woelfle said that ProSieben was however well-prepared for a price war in the advertising market if it came to it.
